description: G17 follow-up: dedicated store-writer of the audit chain's per-tenant mirror (customer/<tenant>/logs/audit/). libs/core/authority.ts registers it as the audit chain's tenant mirror writer context, always bound to the entry's tenant, so the grant resolves through ${KYBERION_TENANT} to that one tenant's mirror directory. It grants no read and no other write; nothing else assumes it (resident dots and coordination store writers run as infrastructure_sentinel, which has no customer/ grant).
